prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Analysis reveals split pattern champions: rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while catboost leads seasonality capture (0.5543). The overall champion ONLY_CWT_catboost (RMSE=443.15) balances both components effectively. High RMSE spread ratio (5.073) and concept drift detected suggest decomposition-aware stacking is optimal to exploit complementary strengths across trend and seasonal components.
